mathematical_definition: OLS slope of delta_close[t] ~ (close[t-1] - rolling_mean[t-1]) over a trailing 60-bar window (numba kernel mean_reversion_speed) -- an empirical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-style mean-reversion-speed coefficient, distinct from the Hurst exponent (a scaling-law estimate) already in the base feature set
numerical_stability_notes: 0.0 when the deviation sum-of-squares denominator is below 1e-15 (degenerate near-constant window), never a raw division by zero
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first window+1=61 bars (kernel loop starts at i=window+1), never zero-filled otherwise
